blocks.title: Modular programming
blocks.text: Modular programming divides a program into smaller, manageable and reusable pieces called modules, so developers can work on parts independently and reuse code efficiently.
This approach makes complex programs easier to manage and promotes code reuse. Using the main function with modules keeps the code organized and easy to maintain (For Your Information).
